name: mantle-starters
description: Minimal provision bundles for Mantle sites.

scripts.build:provision-bundle: pnpm --dir blank generate && pnpm generate:overlays && node scripts/build-provision-bundle.mjs
scripts.check:provision-bundle: pnpm --dir blank check:generated && pnpm check:overlay-generated && node scripts/build-provision-bundle.mjs --check
scripts.check:transaction-indexes: pnpm --dir blank exec mantle-harness indexes --manifests ../overlays/transaction/manifests --require-public --format text
scripts.check:packed: pnpm --dir blank check && pnpm check:worker-bundle && pnpm check:transaction-indexes && pnpm smoke:runtime
scripts.check:exact: pnpm check:overlay-generated && pnpm check:repo-local-skills && pnpm check:core-skills && pnpm smoke:provision-bundle && pnpm check:packed
